name: HK416
source: That one girl who always complains. Has some problems interacting with people due to her habit of complaining all the time. Despite that, she is a caring individual. She may complain, but at the end of the day, she will help others out. Has past problems with M16/discipline and insubordination, and is working with 404 as her ‘last chance’ to avoid expulsion from GNK.
